messages:
alex: kicking off kv-prefetch calibration smoke run on llama3-70b-quant (int8/qat). doing a small holdout sweep to catch logits drift + latency. posting command + quick logs shortly.

alex: ```
python run_prefetch_calibration.py \\
  --model llama3-70b-quant
  --warmup 128
  --prefetch-window 64
  --batch 8
  --holdout /mnt/holdouts/qa_compat_50.jsonl
  --out /tmp/kvcalc_1729991234.json
```

marta: what's the primary quality metric here — ppl or task-acc?

alex: primary: ppl + QA accuracy on the holdout (pairwise agreement). also tracking token-latency, kv hit-rate, and BLEURT for summarization samples.

cj: quick first-pass numbers from the smoke run (seq512):
  - baseline: 38ms/token, acc 87.1%, ppl 11.2
  - prefetch-win=64: 31ms/token, acc 86.2%, ppl 11.4
  -> throughput +22%, latency -18%, acc -0.9pp

marta: small accuracy hit. could be window too aggressive. try 32 and 96, and run 3 seeds. also toggle kv-evict-policy (LRU vs FIFO).

alex: starting run for window=32, 3 seeds. enabling kv-evict=LRU for one seed. will capture per-position hit-rates. ETA ~12m.

sam: prefer canary on a dedicated small pool before wider rollout — avoid noisy regressions hitting hosted. ops, can you queue?

ops-bot: Deploy request queued: canary-cluster-ml-3 scheduled at 2024-06-15T16:20Z. ID: deploy-5821. Notify @eng-oncall on failures.

cj: also noticed outputs are slightly more generic on open-ended summarization samples, not catastrophic but noticeable. saved diffs: /tmp/prefetch_diffs/1729991234/ (examples + logits).

marta: add BLEURT & human n=50 for summarization holdout. if BLEURT drops by >0.5 we block.

alex: added BLEURT and small human check. running seeds now. posting condensed run logs when ready. :thumbsup:

cj: sketch idea: dynamic window based on prefix length could reduce regression. naive heuristic: window = min(64, max(16, prefix_len//2)). smaller windows for short prompts.

marta: +1 to dynamic heuristic. also measure kv hit ratio per-token position and tail position entropy.

alex: paste condensed seed results for window=32 (3 seeds):
  - run1: seq512: 33ms/token, acc 86.8%, ppl 11.3, BLEURT -0.12
  - run2: seq512: 32.5ms/token, acc 86.9%, ppl 11.25, BLEURT -0.08
  - run3: seq512: 33.1ms/token, acc 86.7%, ppl 11.35, BLEURT -0.15
  -> mean acc drop ~0.4pp vs baseline, within noisy threshold per our rule.

sam: looks acceptable for a canary. schedule longer holdout overnight and run the dynamic-window prototype.

ops-bot: Automated benchmark: holdout-run-1729991234 completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-ml/runs/1729991234/summary.json; logs: s3://redwood-ml/runs/1729991234/logs.tar.gz

alex: thanks. I'll open a tiny PR with perf/quality table + dynamic-window patch + suggested revert threshold. PR will include example diffs and the human-sample sheet.

cj: note to self: capture sample-level entropy delta and store with candidate artifacts for offline analysis.

marta: great. if overnight holdout is clean, let's run a small dedicated canary rollout with fallback to baseline on >1pp acc drop.

alex: agreed. closing this thread once PR is up. tagging @sam for rollout approval when ready.

sam: ack.
